title: Stan NDE 31880
content: I'm not sure who would believe this story. I'm not sure I believe it. I think of myself as a very normal person. When I was three my mother passed away. So besides pictures I have no physical memories of her. I cannot go into details regarding exactly how she passed, as I'm not a hundred percent sure but I have heard several different stories. How she passed is unimportant though. She has been gone thirty-five years and by most of the world, forgotten. Around two weeks ago, I started thinking about her and felt a need to find out about her life and the questions I had regarding her death. I contacted her sister after thirty-five years and started getting answers. Anyway, about three days before this experience I felt a presence and that she was overjoyed. I felt it as real as I breathe. It was my mother and she was very happy. So last night my best friend and I are driving and I tell her umm I think my mom is next to me hugging me and telling me it's ok son. My mother is very, very happy. My friend's jaw dropped and she started crying. I thought she would think I was crazy, and she thought I would think she was crazy but at the exact same time, she was watching my mother die in a hospital bed with the doctors working over her. We both had chills and goose bumps at the same time. It was like a rush of energy hitting us both. I can’t believe it happened myself, so I don't expect anyone else to believe it. Yet I swear it happened and I have a witness that shared the experience with me!

arrival.other_being_detail: He reports sensing his deceased mother as a presence next to him, hugging him, and communicating reassurance.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Shared anomalous experience with a friend: he felt his deceased mother present and hugging him while his friend simultaneously perceived the mother dying in a hospital bed.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: He sensed his mother hugging and reassuring him at the same time his friend reported seeing the mother dying in a hospital bed.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: This account describes an apparent shared after-death communication/vision rather than an NDE: the experiencer was not near death and reports sensing his deceased mother while a companion simultaneously perceived the mother dying in a hospital setting.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I felt a presence and that she was overjoyed. I felt it as real as I breathe.”; “I think my mom is next to me hugging me and telling me it's ok son.”; “at the exact same time, she was watching my mother die in a hospital bed with the doctors working over her.”
